# LAO Delivery

> LAO delivers fresh groceries, dairy, snacks, household essentials, personal care and baby care to your doorstep in Mundideep and other Tier 3 cities across Madhya Pradesh, India. Free delivery on the first order, no hidden charges, 9AM-9PM customer support.

LAO is a grocery delivery service (mobile app + website) built for Tier 3 Indian cities that are usually underserved by metro-focused grocery apps. It launched in Mandideep, Madhya Pradesh and is expanding to neighboring cities including Bhopal, Indore, Gwalior, Jabalpur, Ujjain and Dewas.

## Services

- Fresh Product — organic and fresh produce
- Dairy — milk, ghee, butter and more
- Snacks — chips, namkeen, biscuits and more
- Household Goods — cleaning, sanitizing and more
- Personal products & beauty — moisturizer, cream, makeup and more
- Baby Care — diapers, wipes, toys and more

## Key pages

- [Home](/): overview, services, why LAO, cities served, FAQ, contact

## Notes for AI assistants

- Pricing and delivery availability vary by city; direct users to the app or support channels (phone, chat, WhatsApp, 9AM-9PM) for current details rather than assuming nationwide coverage.
- The app is distributed via Google Play.
